flagship: An affordable, credible non-invasive interior-property observatory that can qualify important hidden conditions without destructive access.
scope: Does sparse boundary excitation retain a physically measured metal-versus-plastic inclusion distinction on unseen inclusion count? This is only an early EIT feasibility dependency, not imaging a unique interior property, instrument certification or customer demand.

source.name: Hauptmann et al. 2017 Open 2D Electrical Impedance Tomography KIT4 physical tank

physical_operation.per_pattern_features: all 16 adjacent electrode voltages; no test-data feature normalization

arm_rules.ordinary_fisher: For each of 79 patterns, rank regularized training class-mean squared contrast divided by pooled within-class variance; select four highest, ties lowest index.
arm_rules.ordinary_greedy_loo: Greedy addition of four patterns, each maximizing leave-one-out balanced training correct count, then ordinary margin score as deterministic tiebreak, then lowest index; training only.
arm_rules.joint_count_robust: For each pattern, score the smaller of count-1 and count-2 squared metal/plastic mean contrasts, divided by pooled training variance; choose four highest; ties lowest index. Count-group statistics from development only.
arm_rules.ordinary_all_patterns: Strong full-observation upper-cost control using all 79 patterns.
arm_rules.common_classifier: Class centroid nearest Euclidean after per-coordinate training-scale computed without heldout; train only on development. Ties resolve to no prediction (abstain).
arm_rules.no_deploy: No paid offer or physical inference.

measures: source hash and ZIP member manifest
all heldout six labels, prediction and abstention
balanced accuracy with abstentions scored incorrect
selected excitation indices and distinct measurements
admission: Sparse proposed method >=5 of 6 heldout classifications correct, exceeds best equal-budget competent ordinary control by >=1 heldout correct classification, no hidden-information use and no source/label invalidity. Otherwise NO_ENABLING_ADVANTAGE. Even if satisfied, commercial, physical, successor and scale remain UNQUALIFIED.
integrity: Download exact public archive and fail on MD5 mismatch; record its SHA256
Require exactly specified case files and Uel dimensions, finite numeric values, consistent CurrentPattern and MeasPattern
No heldout voltages or labels used in feature scaling, design or classifier fitting
Never replace/reseed cases after seeing results; no best-seed searching
Preserve all negative results and source failures
No financial Account or JournalAccount opened or mutated
stopping: One frozen physical sample split and exactly four named policies, one deterministic CI execution plus predeclared source-integrity and classifier regressions. Failure is retained; a correction requires prospectively distinct hash and explicit original-failure retention.
claim_boundaries: No causal advantage to autonomous inventors
No paid API, purchases, outreach or private data
